1.explanation: Both documents live under the UIShell directory, where the Carbon team describes how to wire up HeaderContainer, HeaderMenuButton, SideNav, SideNavItems, and SideNavLink—including props like expanded and isPersistent and how the overlay should behave. Reviewing these two files will show the recommended markup, event callbacks, and expected collapse/expand logic, which is precisely where the overlay-click and link-click behaviors are defined (or currently missing) in order to reproduce and debug this issue.
1.bug_scenario: On small or medium viewports the Carbon UI Shell’s SideNav expands over the page and a gray overlay covers the content. In the screenshot the user is instructed to click either on any SideNavLink (e.g. “Resources”), on the overlay (the gray shaded area), or on the menu bar (the top header), but none of those clicks actually collapse the SideNav as expected. Instead the nav remains open, and only the HeaderMenuButton (hamburger/cross icon) will toggle it closed. The bug affects both clicks on navigation items and clicks outside of the nav (overlay or header) – the SideNav never auto-closes on those interactions.
